cohort: The study included 240 extremely low birth weight infants (ELBWIs), with 18 FIP patients matched to 222 controls by gestational age.
finding: Significantly lower levels of fibrinogen and factor XIII (F-XIII) at birth were found in ELBWIs who developed FIP, suggesting these are potential predictors of FIP.
birth_weight: Extremely low birth weight infants (ELBWIs); the FIP group had significantly lower birth weight than the control group.
gest_age: The FIP group had a significantly younger gestational age at birth; patients were matched according to gestational age.
